story.label: Start location
story.help: The location the player starts in

story.label: Title
story.help: Big, on the start screen, e.g. STRANDED

story.label: Blurb
story.help: Under the title on the start screen

story.label: Intro
story.help: The first thing printed when the game starts

story.label: Meter name
story.help: What the clock is called, e.g. OXYGEN or DAYLIGHT

story.label: Won title
story.help: The end screen's title when you win

story.label: Lost title
story.help: The end screen's title when you lose

story.label: Won message
story.help: The end screen's message when you win. {moves} is replaced by the number of moves

story.label: Lost message
story.help: The end screen's message when you lose. {moves} is replaced by the number of moves

node.label: Mini map column
node.help: Where the location is drawn on the mini map, across (0 is the left)

node.label: Mini map row
node.help: Where the location is drawn on the mini map, down (0 is the top)

node.label: Description when dark
node.help: Makes this a dark location: what the player sees here without a light

node.label: Items
node.help: The items lying here when the game starts

fields.label: Special type
fields.help: A special item, with its own behaviour. Leave as (none) for a plain item

fields.label: Description
fields.help: A plain item's description, shown by EXAMINE
